name: Jerusalem Post
text: Several Muslim-majority countries have denounced an Israeli military strike on a Gaza hospital and urged an end to aid restrictions, after the IDF and Shin Bet said it targeted a Hamas brigade commander.

name: Xinhua
text: Yemen's warring parties reported heavy casualties following a new round of attacks.

name: Reuters
text: Zelenskiy says the United States floated the idea of Ukraine giving up Donbas in exchange for NATO membership.

name: Al Jazeera
text: US envoy Kushner says he hopes to mediate talks between Europe and Russia on Ukraine, as direct European engagement with Moscow appears closer to happening.

name: Euronews
text: Moscow has eased its earlier opposition and now says it will not decide whether European Union representatives take part in Ukraine negotiations.

name: Iran International
text: Democratic lawmakers plan to push legislation to end the US war with Iran once they take control of Congress, following their midterm election gains, while Republicans remain opposed.

name: France 24
text: French President Emmanuel Macron warned that cutting aid to Ukraine would push Kyiv toward an unjust peace and could lead to another war, as the US considers its support.

name: Le Monde
text: Emmanuel Macron says cutting aid to Ukraine would lead to further fighting, as US-brokered talks between Kyiv and Moscow continue to try to end the war that began with Russia's 2022 invasion.

name: Xinhua
text: Leaders meeting in Dublin discussed Europe's expanding part in Ukraine negotiations and the difficulties artificial intelligence poses.

name: Iran International
text: Iranian state television warned that upgraded versions of the Khorramshahr ballistic missile could strike a US air base in Britain.

name: Mehr News
text: Yemen's armed forces say they struck gatherings of Saudi-backed forces at several points in Lahj province, reporting dozens of fighters killed or wounded.

name: The New Arab
text: The UN says it cannot inspect Iran's nuclear sites following US and Israeli strikes, which the two countries framed as efforts to stop Iran building nuclear weapons.

name: AP
text: Following shifting rhetoric from Iran after the US elections, Trump has left the outlook for the Middle East uncertain as he departs the region without a clear plan.

name: Asharq Al-Awsat
text: Saudi Arabia and 17 other Arab and Islamic countries condemned an Israeli strike on the Nasser Medical Complex in Gaza.

name: AP
text: Trump, Xi and Putin are reportedly preparing a rare three-way meeting on the sidelines of the APEC summit, according to the White House and Kremlin.

name: Al Jazeera
text: Reports say Washington proposed that Ukraine give up parts of Donbas to Russia in exchange for NATO membership, a idea Zelenskyy turned down, refusing both neutrality and territorial concessions.

name: Asharq Al-Awsat
text: A coalition force intercepted and destroyed two Houthi drones launched toward Riyadh and southern regions of Saudi Arabia.
